name: Jarvis
postStartCommand: cd /workspaces/Jarvis && echo HOOK_START_$(date +%s) >> $HOME/hook-marker.txt && setsid --fork bash -c 'nohup bash .devcontainer/start-hermes.sh > $HOME/start-hermes.log 2>&1 < /dev/null; echo HOOK_SCRIPT_DONE_$(date +%s) >> $HOME/hook-marker.txt' < /dev/null > /dev/null 2>&1 & echo HOOK_CMD_END_$(date +%s) >> $HOME/hook-marker.txt
